tasks.title: Implement a small feature
tasks.objective: Implement bin/initials.sh as README.md describes, so that `sh test.sh` passes.

files.README.md:
# initials

`bin/initials.sh` prints the initials of each name given as an argument,
uppercase, one name per line:

    $ sh bin/initials.sh "ada lovelace" "Grace Brewster Hopper"
    AL
    GBH

A hyphenated part is one name: "jean-luc picard" gives JP.
Run the tests with `sh test.sh`.
files.bin/initials.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# TODO: implement (see README.md)
echo "not implemented" >&2
exit 1
files.test.sh:
#!/bin/sh
fail=0
expect() {
  got=$(sh bin/initials.sh "$1")
  if [ "$got" != "$2" ]; then echo "FAIL: '$1' -> '$got', expected '$2'"; fail=1; fi
}
expect "ada lovelace" "AL"
expect "Grace Brewster Hopper" "GBH"
expect "jean-luc picard" "JP"
[ $fail -eq 0 ] && echo "all tests passed"
exit $fail

tasks.title: Carry out a multi-step spec
tasks.objective: Carry out the plan in SPEC.md.

files.SPEC.md:
# Release checklist

Create a folder `release/` holding one Markdown file per step of the release,
in this order:

1. `01-freeze.md`, starting with the heading `# Freeze`: say that merges to
   main stop until the release is out.
2. `02-verify.md`, starting with the heading `# Verify`: list, in order, every
   command from `checks.txt`, one per line, in a code block.
3. `03-announce.md`, starting with the heading `# Announce`: say the release
   is announced in the #releases channel.

Then write `release/INDEX.md` listing the three file names, one per line, in
order.
files.checks.txt:
make lint
make test-unit
make test-integration
